title: Samsung Warns Chip Shortages May Persist Till 2028 As AI Demand Drives Record Profits
description: Samsung Electronics expects semiconductor shortages to intensify through 2028 as demand from artificial intelligence infrastructure continues to rise. The company reported a massive jump in chip profits, supported by memory demand and long-term data centre contracts. However, strong chip performance has also increased pressure on its mobile business due to higher component costs
content:
Samsung Electronics has warned that the global semiconductor shortage could worsen in the coming years and continue until 2028, as artificial intelligence-driven demand keeps pressure on chip supplies.
